cases.name: Karen Ann Alexander
cases.caseStatus: CODIS / DNA MATCH; SUSPECT DECEASED WHEN ID'D
cases.narrative: On 4/8/1981, police found her and her 13-year-old brother were found stabbed in their Texarkana home. Gordon, who was confined to a wheelchair at the time, was found dead in the kitchen while Karen was found on a bed in the living room still alive, but suffering from stab wounds. Police said the murder weapon used was a butter knife, which they recovered from the scene. Karen was taken to a local hospital, where she spent three days in a coma before dying from her injuries. An autopsy at the time revealed that Karen had been sexually assaulted 48 to 72 hours before she died and had likely been sexually assaulted for about six months leading up to her death, police said at the press conference. DNA testing revealed semen that was discovered on her bedding belonged to her father, Weldon.
